Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2. The petitioner has prayed for regular bail in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 341, 342, 324, 326, 498A, 323, 504 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Allegation against the petitioner is that he used to torture, assault and harass of his wife(informant).
4.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
The petitioner is the husband of the informant due to which he has falsely been implicated in this case.

It is further submitted that petitioner is ready to keep his wife with dignity and honour and Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.61288 of 2023(2) dt.15-09-2023 the marriage of the petitioner with the informant solemnized nineteen years ago and both of them blessed with two children.
As far as the injuries of the informant is concerned, the doctor opined that the nature of injuries is simple in nature.
Moreover, the petitioner is languishing in judicial custody since 02.05.2023.
5. Learned APP appearing for the state has opposed the prayer of regular bail.
